CustomField.formula:
IF( ISBLANK(XQA_Score__c), " ",
IF( AND(XQA_Score__c >=0 , XQA_Score__c <=33, Total_Account_ARR__c >0),"At-Risk",
IF( AND(XQA_Score__c >=0 , XQA_Score__c <=33, (ISBLANK(Total_Account_ARR__c) || Total_Account_ARR__c =0)),"Low",
IF( AND(XQA_Score__c >=34 , XQA_Score__c <=67, Total_Account_ARR__c >0),"Neutral",
IF( AND(XQA_Score__c >=34 , XQA_Score__c <=67, (ISBLANK(Total_Account_ARR__c) || Total_Account_ARR__c =0)),"Medium",
IF( AND(XQA_Score__c >=68 , XQA_Score__c <=100, Total_Account_ARR__c >0),"Growth",
IF( AND(XQA_Score__c >=68 , XQA_Score__c <=100, (ISBLANK(Total_Account_ARR__c) || Total_Account_ARR__c =0)),"High", " ")))))))
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Derived by the Expansion Score - evaluates account health for Paid accounts and conversion propensity for Free accounts
